header: SYNTHETIC — invented meeting text, spoken by macOS `say` at run time for the Day Recorder whisper spike.
paragraphs: Good morning everyone, thanks for joining the weekly planning call.
First item: the onboarding redesign. Riley, where are we on the new welcome flow?
We finished the first three screens yesterday. I'll send the deck by Thursday so Casey can review it before Friday's demo.
Great. Please block two hours on Wednesday afternoon for the accessibility pass, and add a task to update the color tokens.
Second item: the billing migration. We moved forty percent of accounts last week with no failed payments.
The remaining accounts move in two batches, on October twenty eighth and November fourth.
Jordan will draft a status update for the platform channel and share it before it goes out.
Last item: the quarterly offsite. We're looking at the second week of December, probably in Austin.
If you have dietary restrictions, reply to the survey by the end of the month.
That's everything for today. Thanks, and see you next week.
